items.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T
items.title_zh: Qwen开源2.4万亿参数MoE模型Qwen3.8-2.4T，激活参数95B
items.title_en: Qwen Releases Qwen3.8-2.4T: 2.4T-Parameter MoE with 95B Active
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.8-2.4T, a 2.4-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 95B active parameters, reportedly performing at or near the level of leading models like Opus 4.5 and Fable 5.

items.title: Grok 4.6
items.title_zh: xAI 发布 Grok 4.6，引发 API 与基准测试争议
items.title_en: xAI Releases Grok 4.6, Sparking API and Benchmark Debates
items.summary: xAI announces Grok 4.6, a new frontier AI model, sparking community debate over API behavior and performance authenticity.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 上线 OpenRouter，引发基准测试与定价热议
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 Debuts on OpenRouter, Sparking Benchmark Debate
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 model released on OpenRouter, sparking extensive discussion about performance, benchmarks, and pricing.

items.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
items.title_zh: Tailscale 将数据库损坏追溯至 16 年前的 SQLite WAL-Reset 缺陷
items.title_en: Tailscale Traces DB Corruption to 16-Year-Old SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
items.summary: Tailscale traces a database corruption issue to a 16-year-old SQLite WAL-reset race condition and funded an open-source VFS shim to isolate it.

items.title: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
items.title_zh: 为何微小 JPEG 在 Chrome 中显示不同
items.title_en: Why Tiny JPEGs Look Different in Chrome
items.summary: Explains how Chrome's partial JPEG decoding optimization causes tiny images to appear different compared to Firefox, and advises against using JPEGs for small icons.

items.title: uBlock Origin Is Giving Up the Fight to Keep Ads Off Facebook
items.title_zh: uBlock Origin 放弃屏蔽 Facebook 广告
items.title_en: uBlock Origin Withdraws From Blocking Facebook Ads
items.summary: uBlock Origin has stopped fighting to block Facebook ads due to the platform's increasingly difficult anti-adblocking measures, sparking a wide-ranging discussion on ad-blocking future and Facebook's role.

items.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering?
items.title_zh: AI正在让软件工程的中层岗位消失吗？
items.title_en: AI Is Removing the Middle Class of Software Engineering?
items.summary: The article argues AI is eliminating the middle class of software engineering by automating routine coding tasks, while amplifying the impact of both capable and poor engineers, sparking a rich community debate.

items.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
items.title_zh: 车牌读取器搜索须获搜查令
items.title_en: Warrant Needed for License Plate Reader Searches
items.summary: A blog post arguing that law enforcement should need a warrant to search license plate reader data, sparking debate about mass surveillance and technology safeguards.

items.title: What sort of maths are LLMs good at?
items.title_zh: 高尔斯探讨LLM擅长何种数学任务
items.title_en: Gowers probes which math tasks LLMs handle well
items.summary: Timothy Gowers explores which mathematical tasks LLMs are good at, sparking a deep community discussion on test-time scaling, sampling, and the potential for AI to produce beautiful proofs.

items.title: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
items.title_zh: Woxi：用Rust编写的开源Wolfram语言解释器
items.title_en: Woxi: Open-Source Wolfram Language Interpreter Written in Rust
items.summary: Woxi is an open-source Rust-based interpreter for the Wolfram Language with a GUI, CLI, Jupyter kernel, and WASM support, positioning itself as a fast and free alternative to Mathematica.

items.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.title_zh: 研究人员窃取专有LLM API的隐藏推理痕迹
items.title_en: Researchers Steal Hidden Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.summary: A security paper demonstrates that encrypted chain-of-thought traces from frontier LLM APIs can be replayed into weaker models and jailbroken to reveal the original hidden reasoning.

items.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, But Adam Does [R]
items.title_zh: 为何Adam会失去GD的隐式低秩偏差
items.title_en: Why Adam Loses GD's Implicit Low-Rank Bias
items.summary: Demonstrates that Adam's per-coordinate second moment breaks rotational invariance and thereby loses GD's implicit low-rank bias, unlike optimizers like Muon and Shampoo.

items.title: LTX 发布开源视频模型 LTX-2.5，单张 RTX 5090 即可本地运行
items.title_zh: LTX 发布开源视频模型 LTX-2.5，单张 RTX 5090 即可运行
items.title_en: LTX Releases Open-Source Video Model LTX-2.5, Runs on RTX 5090
items.summary: LTX releases open-source video generation model LTX-2.5, runnable on a single RTX 5090 with weights, training code, and inference pipeline fully open.

items.title: 微信团队发布 WeLM，大语言模型家族以资源效率为核心
items.title_zh: 微信发布资源高效的 WeLM 大语言模型系列
items.title_en: WeChat Releases WeLM, Resource-Efficient LLM Family
items.summary: WeChat Team releases WeLM, a resource-efficient large language model family including a 80B/3B-active model for production and a MoE-based 617B/23B-active model for future complex tasks.

items.summary: DeepSeek launches V4-Flash official API public beta with enhanced agent capabilities and strong benchmark scores.
